templates.name: appointment_confirmation
templates.used_for: Right after a booking made outside an open WhatsApp conversation
templates.body: Hi, your appointment with {{business_name}} is booked for {{date}} at {{time}}. Reply here if you need to change it.

templates.name: appointment_reminder_24h
templates.body: Reminder: your appointment with {{business_name}} is tomorrow, {{date}} at {{time}}. Please confirm or reschedule below.

templates.name: appointment_reminder_2h
templates.body: Reminder: your appointment with {{business_name}} is today at {{time}}. Please confirm or reschedule below.

templates.name: quote_ready
templates.body: Hi, your quote from {{business_name}} is ready. Reply here with any questions.

templates.name: quote_followup
templates.used_for: Day 2 and day 5 after a quote
templates.body: Hi, just checking you received your quote from {{business_name}}. Reply here if you have any questions.

templates.name: invoice_ready
templates.body: Hi, your invoice from {{business_name}} is ready.

templates.name: invoice_reminder
templates.body: Hi, a reminder that your invoice from {{business_name}} is now due.

templates.name: review_request
templates.used_for: After a completed job (utility only if tied to that job, otherwise marketing)
templates.body: Thanks for choosing {{business_name}} for your {{job}}. Would you leave us a review? {{review_link}}

templates.name: noshow_rebook
templates.body: Hi, we missed you today at {{business_name}}. Would you like to rebook?

templates.name: reactivation
templates.body: Hi, it has been a while since your last visit to {{business_name}}. Reply if you would like to book.
